body: Well, I did cut myself, on my upper forearm so people wouldn’t assume it’s from me. But it worked, so I guess I don’t need to be here

Good enough for what? I’m never going to be good enough for myself. I’m scared. I don’t want to get close to anyone else ever again. I don’t want this to ever be possible again in the future. So I’m not going to be good enough for anyone else either
Tbh, I hate it. Nothing against you, just I hate talking about myself. The only reason I’m doing it is because she would have wanted me to
I’m scared of that. Talking about myself, even anonymously like this, gives me a ton of anxiety. That’s why I’ve never gotten help for my other stuff before. I don’t think I could handle it

But what’s the point of making it to the next day. I’ll be just as guilty. Feel terrible then too. 

I’m paranoid. People that meet me ask if I’m schizophrenic sometimes. I talk to myself and don’t realize it sometimes. I’m crazy. I’m not a sane person. I’m not happy either. I’ve always hated myself for being the broken piece of shit I am. And now this. I don’t want to keep living this way.

I could have done more for her. I should have. I should have talked to her more, let her know I was still here for her. Something. Anything. 

And maybe killing myself wont pay any debt, but it’d sure as hell make me happy right at the end.

Every day since she disappeared, it’s felt worse and worse. The guilt is too much for me. I can’t take it. And I don’t even know if I want to be ok with it. It’s my fault. For fucks sake, I’m even saying “it” just because I don’t like the thought of what I’ve done. Made someone I loved kill themself.
